result.title: QASK-Edit: Adaptive Sparse Attention Across Queries and Key Sources for Efficient Video Editing
result.summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in generation based video editing, but suffer from high inference latency due to the long token sequences formed by conditioning inputs and generated videos. Although training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, existing methods typically apply a fixed retention ratio or a single threshold shared across all tokens. In this work, we view video editing as conditional generation and identify a key insight: attention demand varies significantly both across different key sources (e.g., source videos, reference images, audio, text, and generated videos) and across queries within each source. Motivated by this, we propose QASK-Edit (Query-Adaptive Sparsity over Key Sources for Video Editing), a training-free sparse attention framework that allocates computation independently for each query and key source. Specifically, for each query, QASK-Edit considers both the attention mass and approximation risk of each block. It then evaluates candidate routing thresholds against each key source's risk budget, choosing exact computation or approximations to dynamically adjust sparsity for each query. Extensive experiments on three video editing models demonstrate that QASK-Edit achieves up to $1.46\times$ end-to-end speedup over dense attention pipeline while preserving both editing quality and unedited region fidelity. Furthermore, QASK-Edit generalizes directly to Reference-to-Video generation, delivering up to $1.36\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练稀疏注意力框架 QASK-Edit，针对 DiT 视频编辑，按每个 query 与每种 key source（源视频、参考图、音频、文本、生成帧）分别评估注意力质量与近似风险，在风险预算下选择路由阈值以分配精确或近似计算，从而降低推理延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按 query 与证据源分配计算并在风险预算下动态路由」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据源筛选与动态计算预算分配提供注意力结构层面的可核查线索，但属视频生成加速场景，迁移需较多验证。
